# RemoveAt

Removes the element at a given position of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RemoveAt(items, index)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to remove from, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `index` | number | The position of the element to remove, counted from 0. A whole number that names an element of items, from 0 to one less than its length; a negative, fractional or larger number, or null, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of items without the one at index, in order. Never null.

## Example

`RemoveAt([1, 2, 3], 1)` returns `[1, 3]`.
